# The History of Art

> > A comprehensive resource exploring Renaissance masters, American landscape painters, and European art movements through artist biographies, artwork analyses, and historical context.

The History of Art provides detailed coverage of major artists including Albrecht Dürer, Albert Bierstadt, Andrea del Verrocchio, and Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, with emphasis on Renaissance art, 19th-century American landscape painting, and Spanish Baroque traditions. The site offers artwork descriptions, artist biographies, and historical insights into movements like the Hudson River School and Italian Renaissance.

- Renaissance art
- Italian Renaissance
- Albrecht Dürer
- Albert Bierstadt

## Renaissance Masters

- [Donato Bramante Architecture, Drawings and Biography](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/donato-bramante): Bramante: Renaissance architect of St. Peter's Basilica & biography
- [Andrea del Verrocchio Biography](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/andrea-del-verrocchio/biography): Verrocchio biography: Florentine sculptor, goldsmith & Medici patronage
- [Andrea del Verrocchio Paintings](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/andrea-del-verrocchio/paintings): Verrocchio paintings: Renaissance tempera, Leonardo's teacher & Botticelli
- [Pentecost by Giotto di Bondone](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/giotto/pentecost): Giotto's Pentecost fresco: Renaissance religious naturalism technique

## Albrecht Dürer Artworks

- [The Adoration of the Magi by Albrecht Durer](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albrecht-durer/adoration-of-the-magi): Dürer's Adoration of Magi: 1504 Northern Renaissance oil at Uffizi
- [Apollo and Diana by Albrecht Durer](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albrecht-durer/apollo-and-diana): Dürer's Apollo & Diana engraving: 1503 Greek mythology & human proportions
- [Madonna and Child with the Pear by Albrecht Durer](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albrecht-durer/madonna-and-child-with-the-pear): Dürer's Madonna with Pear: Renaissance religious symbolism at Uffizi
- [St George on Horseback by Albrecht Durer](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albrecht-durer/st-george-on-horseback): Dürer's St George engraving: 1505 dragon-slaying Christian martyr artwork
- [Wire Drawing Mill by Albrecht Durer](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albrecht-durer/wire-drawing-mill): Dürer's Wire Drawing Mill: Nuremberg watercolor with perspective study
- [Walrus by Albrecht Durer](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albrecht-durer/walrus): Dürer's Walrus artwork: Renaissance animal study with print options
- [Greyhound by Albrecht Durer](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albrecht-durer/greyhound): Dürer's Greyhound: Renaissance animal art with available prints

## Albert Bierstadt Landscapes

- [Mirror Lake, Yosemite Valley by Albert Bierstadt](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albert-bierstadt/mirror-lake-yosemite-valley): Bierstadt's Mirror Lake Yosemite: 1864 Hudson River School landscape
- [Sunset in the Yosemite Valley by Albert Bierstadt](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albert-bierstadt/sunset-in-the-yosemite-valley): Bierstadt's Yosemite Sunset: 1865 realist California landscape painting
- [The Buffalo Trail by Albert Bierstadt](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albert-bierstadt/buffalo-trail): Bierstadt's The Buffalo Trail: 19th-century American bison landscape
- [Alaskan Coast Range by Albert Bierstadt](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albert-bierstadt/alaskan-coast-range): Bierstadt's Alaskan Coast Range: Rocky Mountain School landscape painting
- [The Morteratsch Glacier Upper Engadine Valley Pontresina by Albert Bierstadt](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albert-bierstadt/morteratsch-glacier-upper-engadine-valley-pontresina): Bierstadt's Morteratsch Glacier: Swiss landscape Romanticism painting
- [Landscape (1902) by Albert Bierstadt](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albert-bierstadt/landscape-1902): Bierstadt's final Landscape (1902): Storm Clouds oil painting

## Spanish Baroque Art

- [Bartolomé Esteban Murillo Paintings](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/bartolome-esteban-murillo/infant-saint-john-the-baptist): Murillo paintings: Spanish Baroque religious art from Seville

## Artist Quotes & Reference

- [Albert Bierstadt Quotes](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/albert-bierstadt/quotes): Bierstadt quotes: American West landscapes & nature conservation views
- [Bartolomé Esteban Murillo Quotes](https://www.thehistoryofart.org/bartolome-esteban-murillo/quotes): Murillo quotes: Spanish Baroque painter from Seville on art & technique
